description: This file defines the 'NotIn' validation rule class used within the OrangeHRM system, specifically as a part of the API v2 validator rules. It checks whether a given input value is not present in a specified list (haystack).

classes.name: NotIn
classes.description: A validation rule class that verifies whether a given input is not included in a predefined array (haystack). It supports strict comparison based on the compareIdentical flag.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the haystack array and the compareIdentical boolean flag.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation check to confirm the input is not in the haystack, respecting the strict comparison flag.
